run_evaluation_by_name: run a named evaluation by dynamically importing and executing its eval module
run_app_evaluation: run an app-prefixed evaluation module using the scaffold main function
run_evaluation_with_resume: run an evaluation with resume capability for preempted jobs
review_main_function: review the main function that dynamically imports and dispatches evaluation modules
summarize_scaffold: summarize the eval runner scaffold that routes evaluation names to their modules
